roles.algo: 位于工具调用环节，把模型与外部工具和数据连接起来。

en.what: The official Python SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP): expose tools and data to LLM apps through one standard, or call them from an app.
en.before: Each LLM app wrote its own integration code, so the same tool had to be re-adapted for every app.

roles.dev: Write an addition tool with FastMCP and call it from an MCP client.
roles.pm: Lowers the cost of connecting agents to internal systems, files and third-party tools.
roles.qa: Test tool argument validation, permission overreach, dropped connections and timeouts.
roles.algo: Sits in the tool-calling step, connecting models to external tools and data.
